pages.quiz:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many full stops are needed in: The sky is dark. Rain is coming. (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. None
   C. One
   D. Three

2. Which letter hangs below the base line in English handwriting? (1 mark)
   A. c
   B. a
   C. g
   D. o

3. What is wrong with: it rained all night. (1 mark)
   A. It needs two full stops
   B. It needs no changes
   C. It needs a capital letter at the start
   D. It needs a comma after it

4. A good comment during a gallery walk is (1 mark)
   A. You cannot write
   B. This is ugly
   C. Your spacing is very even
   D. Nothing to say

5. Which interjection shows praise? (1 mark)
   A. Ouch
   B. Bravo
   C. Yuck
   D. Oops

6. What is a refrain? (1 mark)
   A. A line that is repeated
   B. A rhyme only
   C. A page
   D. The title

7. What should you check when you reorder jumbled words? (1 mark)
   A. That the sentence makes sense and has a verb
   B. The paper
   C. The colour of the letters
   D. Nothing

8. What does Honesty is the best policy teach? (1 mark)
   A. Only rich people are honest
   B. Telling the truth is the wisest choice
   C. Truth is unimportant
   D. Lying is fine

9. What does a moderator do in a panel discussion? (1 mark)
   A. Leaves
   B. Guides the discussion and gives turns
   C. Sleeps
   D. Speaks all the time

10. What is community service? (1 mark)
   A. Playing only
   B. Sleeping
   C. Helping the community without pay
   D. Selling goods

11. Which is the best first step to find the meaning of a new word in a sentence? (1 mark)
   A. Tear the page
   B. Read the words around it for clues
   C. Skip the whole page
   D. Ask nobody

12. What is a dialogue? (1 mark)
   A. A list
   B. A conversation between two or more people
   C. A long description
   D. A map

13. What does a comma tell a reader? (1 mark)
   A. To turn the page
   B. To shout
   C. To stop completely
   D. To take a short pause

14. Which of these is NOT a way of building vocabulary? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping a word bank
   B. Never looking at new words
   C. Making flashcards
   D. Using a dictionary

15. In the metaphor Time is money, what is the meaning? (1 mark)
   A. Money is a clock
   B. Clocks are coins
   C. Time is valuable and should not be wasted
   D. Time is made of paper

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. List three habits of an attentive listener. (3 marks)

17. Name two prepositions used to show position. (2 marks)

18. Compose a short poem of four lines about caring for animals. Make two lines rhyme. (5 marks)

19. Explain what the proverb Many hands make light work means. (2 marks)

20. Name three questions to ask yourself before telling a personal experience. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Two
   There are two sentences, so two full stops.

2. C — g
   The letter g has a tail that goes below the line.

3. C — It needs a capital letter at the start
   The first word of a sentence must begin with a capital letter.

4. C — Your spacing is very even
   Kind and specific comments help writers.

5. B — Bravo
   Bravo praises good work.

6. A — A line that is repeated
   A refrain is repeated in a poem or song.

7. A — That the sentence makes sense and has a verb
   A sentence must make sense.

8. B — Telling the truth is the wisest choice
   It praises honesty.

9. B — Guides the discussion and gives turns
   The moderator keeps order.

10. C — Helping the community without pay
   Community service benefits others.

11. B — Read the words around it for clues
   Context clues are the words nearby.

12. B — A conversation between two or more people
   A dialogue is people talking.

13. D — To take a short pause
   Commas show short pauses.

14. B — Never looking at new words
   Ignoring new words does not build vocabulary.

15. C — Time is valuable and should not be wasted
   The metaphor shows the value of time.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Face the speaker, stay quiet, think about the words, wait for your turn, respond correctly (any three).
   Working / marking points: One mark for each habit, up to three.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: on, in, under, behind, beside, between, in front of, outside (any two).
   Working / marking points: One mark for each.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any four-line poem on the theme with a pair of rhyming lines, for example Feed the hen at break of day, Give her water, let her play, Kind hands keep her safe and well, That is how we care, we tell.
   Working / marking points: Two marks for theme, two marks for four lines and one mark for a rhyming pair.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: When people share a task, the work becomes easier and faster.
   Working / marking points: One mark for sharing work and one for easier work.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Who was there, what happened, where, when, why, how did I feel.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each question.
